voice: Simulate GPU infrastructure on CPU nodes.
Your tools see the driver footprint they expect and run unmodified.
To get started, install Mokka with Helm on Kind.
The GPU Operator advertises four GPUs.
GPU Feature Discovery labels the node, and DCGM reports temperature.
The DRA driver publishes four GPUs. A pod claims one.
Inside, nvidia-smi sees only that GPU.
For CI, start Kind, install a pinned Mokka chart, and wait for the DaemonSet.
Mokka supports MIG partitioning, NRI injection, and GPU fault injection.
Try integrations with Slinky, Dynamo, Topograph, and NVSentinel.
Find Mokka on GitHub and explore the guides.
